ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #1
====

GRADE: Grade 2
SUBJECT: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Only carbon dioxide
   B. Only water vapour
   C. Glucose and oxygen
   D. Nitrogen gas only

2. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. A mixture of two liquids
   B. Any white crystal used in cooking
   C. Any substance that conducts electricity
   D. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means

3. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Animals resources? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Animals resources.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Animals resources.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Animals resources.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Animals resources.

4. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 50 °C
   B. 37 °C
   C. 0 °C
   D. 100 °C

5. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Petrol fires have no fuel
   B. Water always increases oxygen
   C. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   D. Water removes heat too quickly

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Transporting? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Transporting.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Transporting.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Transporting.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Transporting.

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Water its resources? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Water its resources.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Water its resources.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Water its resources.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Water its resources.

8. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Burning crop residue every week
   B. Overgrazing continuously
   C. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   D. Removing all vegetation

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Soil and its resources? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Soil and its resources.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Soil and its resources.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Soil and its resources.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Soil and its resources.

10. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   B. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   C. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   D. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying School environment environment? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about School environment environment.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on School environment environment.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to School environment environment.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for School environment environment.

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Precautions when using? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Precautions when using.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Precautions when using.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Precautions when using.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Precautions when using.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain School environment environment and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Keeping and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Keeping Safe and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain The National and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
MARKING SCHEME
====

1. C — Glucose and oxygen

2. D — A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means

3. C — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Animals resources.

4. D — 100 °C

5. C — Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely

6. A — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Transporting.

7. D — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Water its resources.

8. C — Planting cover crops and terracing slopes

9. C — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Soil and its resources.

10. D — Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio

11. D — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for School environment environment.

12. D — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Precautions when using.

Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of School environment environment; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

15. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Keeping Safe; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
